Method of Attack: Installing a customized Monero miner on Linux servers by exploiting a five-year-old vulnerability in the Cacti Network Weathermap plugin (CVE-2013-2618)
Downloading and installing a customized version of XMRig Monero mining software
Modifying local cron jobs to trigger a 'watchd0g' Bash script every three minutes to check and restart the miner process
Impacted Systems: Linux servers running Cacti Network Weathermap plugin
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2013-2618 vulnerability in Cacti Network Weathermap plugin
Indicators of Compromise: IOCs and file hashes available (not specified in text)
